newsitem.title: UK: Pearson may launch revamp next month - report.
newsitem.headline: Pearson may launch revamp next month - report.

text.p: New management at media group Pearson Plc, owner of the Financial Times, Madame Tussauds and Penguin Books, could launch a major overhaul of the business as early as next month, the Independent newspaper reported on Tuesday.

Citing unnamed Pearson sources, the Independent said managers at Pearson were studying detailed strategy papers for the company. It added that a round of strategy meetings would be held from January 8, the day on which Marjorie Scardino took over as chief executive.

The future of Pearson's television interests, which include Thames Television and Grundy Worldwide, would also be on the agenda. The company is also considering the sale of its 50 percent stake in investment bank Lazard, the report said.
